info.background_text:
Magician seeking to deceive the world.
After experiencing death once, Cassius carries the motto, “The world is all an illusion.” He roams the universe in search of a way for lifeforms to achieve immortality, treating the death and resurrection experienced in Chaos as a form of immortality.
